description: SmartHomeNG items in VS Code: item tree with resolved structs, search & filter, autocomplete for items/structs/logics, KNX group addresses from the ETS project
command.hideStructItems: Hide struct items (only items from items/)
command.sortFileOrder: Order as in the files (currently: alphabetical)
command.sortAlpha: Sort alphabetically (currently: as in the files)
config.language: Language of the user interface (views, tooltips, autocomplete, messages). Command names and setting descriptions follow the display language of VS Code.
config.language.auto: Display language of VS Code (English if it is not supported)
config.basePath: Path to the SmartHomeNG installation (folder containing `items/`). Empty = first workspace folder that contains `items/`. Example: `\\smarthomeng\SmartHomeNG`
config.knxProject: Path to the ETS project (`.knxproj`, exported without a password). Provides group addresses with name and DPT for autocomplete of `knx_send`, `knx_listen` etc., `knx_dpt` and for hovering group addresses. Example: `C:\Users\…\Project.knxproj`
config.showAttributes: Show attributes as child nodes in the tree
config.showStructItems: Show items that only exist through structs
config.sortAlphabetically: Sort items alphabetically (otherwise in file order)
config.categories: Additional filter categories not tied to a plugin: name → attribute names that put an item into this category. `*` at the end = prefix (e.g. `sv_*`). Every plugin configured in `etc/plugin.yaml` gets a category automatically, built from the `item_attributes` of its `plugin.yaml`.
config.diagnostics: Show warnings for unknown structs, eval_trigger and sh.* references in eval
